description: Hardcoded API key present in insecure_app.js
remediation: Remove from source, load via environment variable (process.env.API_KEY).

description: Hardcoded JWT secret present in insecure_app.js
remediation: Store secret in environment (.env) and rotate regularly.

description: Hardcoded database password present in insecure_app.js
remediation: Use environment variable DB_PASS; never commit credentials.

description: SQL query constructed via string concatenation with user-controlled input (username, password).
remediation: Use parameterized query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ? AND password = ?
Restrict origins to trusted domains using a whitelist function.

description: API response includes API key and JWT secret after login
remediation: Never return secrets. Return a JWT token or session identifier only.

description: Console error logs entire error object in production
remediation: Log sanitized error codes; disable verbose logging in production.

description: Commented example uses eval to run arbitrary code
remediation: Remove eval usage. Implement specific server-side operations instead of executing arbitrary code.
